import math
import mesh = "./mesh.qui"
import materials = "./materials.qui"
import transient = "./transient.qui"
import steady = "./steady.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

real64 minimum(real64 first, real64 second)
    return if first < second then first else second

real64 maximum(real64 first, real64 second)
    return if first > second then first else second

string verdict(bool value)
    return if value then "ok" else "failed"

string yes(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

class Segment(string name, string edge, string kind, int[][] faces, real64 h, real64 theta)
class Source(string name, int[] cells, real64 power, int[][] intervals)
    weight := power / real64(#cells)

    bool operating(int when)
        for interval := intervals[]
            if interval[0] <= when and when < interval[1]
                return true
        return false

    real64 duty(int end_at)
        duration := 0
        for interval := intervals[]
            duration += (if interval[1] < end_at then interval[1] else end_at) - (if interval[0] < end_at then interval[0] else end_at)
        return real64(duration) / real64(end_at)

class Boundary(Segment[] segments, Source[] sources)

Boundary read_boundary(mesh.Mesh plate)
    Segment[] segments := []
    Source[] sources := []
    for row := mesh.lines("input/boundary.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "segment"
            kind := fields[5]
            h := if kind == "convective" then mesh.number(fields[6]) else 0.0
            theta := if kind == "fixed" then mesh.number(fields[6]) elif kind == "convective" then mesh.number(fields[7]) else 0.0
            faces := mesh.segment_faces(plate.width, plate.height, fields[2], mesh.integer(fields[3]), mesh.integer(fields[4]))
            segments = segments.append(Segment(fields[1], fields[2], kind, faces, h, theta))
        else
            cells := mesh.source_cells(plate.width, mesh.integer(fields[2]), mesh.integer(fields[3]), mesh.integer(fields[4]), mesh.integer(fields[5]))
            int[][] intervals := []
            for: 7 <= i < int(#fields) step 2
                intervals = intervals.append([mesh.integer(fields[i]), mesh.integer(fields[i + 1])])
            sources = sources.append(Source(fields[1], cells, mesh.number(fields[6]), intervals))
    return Boundary(segments, sources)

class Probe(string name, int point)
class Run(string name, string method, int step)
    dt := real64(step) / 1000.0

class Params(real64 initial, int end_time, int[] snapshots, int probe_every, Probe[] probes, Run[] runs, string reference, real64 tolerance, int max_iterations, real64 omega, real64[] bands, real64 alarm, real64 limit)

Params read_parameters(int width)
    real64 initial := 0.0
    end_time := 0
    int[] snapshots := []
    probe_every := 0
    Probe[] probes := []
    Run[] runs := []
    reference := ""
    real64 tolerance := 0.0
    max_iterations := 0
    real64 omega := 0.0
    real64[] bands := []
    real64 alarm := 0.0
    real64 limit := 0.0
    for row := mesh.lines("input/params.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        key := fields[0]
        if key == "initial"
            initial = mesh.number(fields[1])
        elif key == "end_time"
            end_time = mesh.integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "snapshots"
            snapshots = [for value := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then mesh.integer(value)]
        elif key == "probe_every"
            probe_every = mesh.integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "probe"
            probes = probes.append(Probe(fields[1], mesh.cell(width, mesh.integer(fields[2]), mesh.integer(fields[3]))))
        elif key == "run"
            runs = runs.append(Run(fields[1], fields[2], mesh.integer(fields[3])))
        elif key == "reference"
            reference = fields[1]
        elif key == "tolerance"
            tolerance = mesh.number(fields[1])
        elif key == "max_iterations"
            max_iterations = mesh.integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "omega"
            omega = mesh.number(fields[1])
        elif key == "bands"
            bands = [for value := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then mesh.number(value)]
        elif key == "alarm"
            alarm = mesh.number(fields[1])
        else
            limit = mesh.number(fields[1])
    return Params(initial, end_time, snapshots, probe_every, probes, runs, reference, tolerance, max_iterations, omega, bands, alarm, limit)

class FieldPower(real64[] field, real64 power)

FieldPower source_terms(Source[] sources, int count, int when)
    real64[] field := [for p := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]
    real64[] powers := []
    for source := sources[]
        if when < 0 or source.operating(when)
            powers = powers.append(source.power)
            for point := source.cells[]
                field[point] += source.weight
    return FieldPower(field, transient.sum(powers))

class System(mesh.Mesh plate, materials.Material[] material_list, Segment[] segments, Source[] sources, int[] cell_material, int[][] material_cells, real64[] capacity, real64[][] g, real64[][] theta, bool[][] boundary, real64[] diagonal, real64[] beta, real64[] source_all, real64 total_power, real64 dt_max)

System build_system(mesh.Mesh plate, materials.Material[] material_list, Boundary data)
    int[] cell_material := []
    int[][] material_cells := [for material := material_list[] then []]
    real64[] capacity := []
    real64[][] g := []
    real64[][] theta := [for p := (0:<int(plate.count))[] then [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]]
    boundary := [for p := (0:<int(plate.count))[] then [false, false, false, false]]
    for: p < plate.count
        index := -1
        for: i < int(#material_list)
            if material_list[i].code == plate.codes[p]
                index = i
        cell_material = cell_material.append(index)
        material_cells[index] = material_cells[index].append(p)
        capacity = capacity.append(materials.capacity(material_list[index], plate.dx, plate.thickness))
    for: p < plate.count
        real64[] faces := []
        for: direction < 4
            neighbor := plate.neighbors[p][direction]
            conductance := if neighbor < 0 then 0.0 else materials.interior(material_list[cell_material[p]].k, material_list[cell_material[neighbor]].k, plate.thickness)
            faces = faces.append(conductance)
        g = g.append(faces)
    for segment := data.segments[]
        for face := segment.faces[]
            p := face[0]
            direction := face[1]
            k := material_list[cell_material[p]].k
            if segment.kind == "fixed"
                g[p][direction] = materials.fixed(k, plate.thickness)
            elif segment.kind == "convective"
                g[p][direction] = materials.convective(k, segment.h, plate.dx, plate.thickness)
            boundary[p][direction] = segment.kind != "insulated"
            theta[p][direction] = segment.theta
    real64[] diagonal := []
    real64[] beta := []
    real64 dt_max := 0.0
    for: p < plate.count
        a := transient.sum(g[p])
        diagonal = diagonal.append(a)
        real64[] terms := []
        for: direction < 4
            if boundary[p][direction]
                terms = terms.append(g[p][direction] * theta[p][direction])
        beta = beta.append(transient.sum(terms))
        step := capacity[p] / a
        if p == 0 or step < dt_max
            dt_max = step
    all := source_terms(data.sources, plate.count, -1)
    return System(plate, material_list, data.segments, data.sources, cell_material, material_cells, capacity, g, theta, boundary, diagonal, beta, all.field, all.power, dt_max)

int hottest(real64[] field)
    point := 0
    for: p < int(#field)
        if field[p] > field[point]
            point = p
    return point

string cell_text(int width, int point)
    return "{point / width} {point % width}"

string summary(string prefix, System system, real64[] field)
    point := hottest(field)
    low := field[0]
    for value := field[]
        low = minimum(low, value)
    return prefix + " max " + report.real_text(field[point], 2) + " at " + cell_text(system.plate.width, point) + " min " + report.real_text(low, 2) + " mean " + report.real_text(transient.sum(field) / real64(system.plate.count), 2)

real64 stored_heat(System system, real64[] field, real64 initial, int[] cells)
    return transient.sum([for p := cells[] then system.capacity[p] * (field[p] - initial)])

real64 segment_flow(System system, Segment segment, real64[] field)
    if segment.kind == "insulated"
        return 0.0
    return transient.sum([for face := segment.faces[] then system.g[face[0]][face[1]] * (segment.theta - field[face[0]])])

string status(Run definition, System system, Params params)
    int[] times := [params.end_time, params.probe_every].concat(params.snapshots)
    for source := system.sources[]
        for interval := source.intervals[]
            times = times.concat(interval)
    for when := times[]
        if when % definition.step != 0
            return "step"
    if definition.method == "ftcs" and definition.dt > system.dt_max
        return "unstable"
    return "accepted"

real64 step_energy(System system, Segment segment, Run definition, real64[] previous, real64[] updated, real64[] intermediate)
    if segment.kind == "insulated"
        return 0.0
    real64[] terms := []
    for face := segment.faces[]
        p := face[0]
        temperature := previous[p]
        if definition.method != "ftcs"
            if segment.edge == "left" or segment.edge == "right"
                temperature = intermediate[p]
            elif definition.method == "backward_euler"
                temperature = updated[p]
            else
                temperature = (previous[p] + updated[p]) / 2.0
        terms = terms.append(system.g[p][face[1]] * (segment.theta - temperature))
    return definition.dt * transient.sum(terms)

class Snapshot(int recorded_at, real64[] field, real64 stored, real64 boundary, real64 generated)
class Sample(int recorded_at, real64[] values)
class RunResult(Run definition, string state)
    steps := 0
    real64[] segment_energy := []
    real64 generated := 0.0
    Snapshot[] snapshots := []
    Sample[] samples := []
    above := 0
    peak_set := false
    real64 peak_temperature := 0.0
    peak_time := 0
    peak_cell := 0
    alarm_time := -1
    alarm_cell := 0
    real64[] final := []
    real64 stored := 0.0
    real64 boundary := 0.0
    balanced := false

void observe(RunResult &result, System system, Params params, int when, real64[] field)
    point := hottest(field)
    temperature := field[point]
    if not result.peak_set or temperature > result.peak_temperature
        result.peak_set = true
        result.peak_temperature = temperature
        result.peak_time = when
        result.peak_cell = point
    if temperature >= params.alarm
        if result.alarm_time < 0
            result.alarm_time = when
            result.alarm_cell = point
        if when > 0
            result.above += result.definition.step
    if when % params.probe_every == 0
        result.samples = result.samples.append(Sample(when, [for probe := params.probes[] then field[probe.point]]))
    for snapshot_time := params.snapshots[]
        if when == snapshot_time
            cells := [for p := (0:<int(system.plate.count))[] then p]
            result.snapshots = result.snapshots.append(Snapshot(when, field, stored_heat(system, field, params.initial, cells), transient.sum(result.segment_energy), result.generated))

RunResult simulate(Run definition, System system, Params params)
    result := RunResult(definition, status(definition, system, params))
    if result.state != "accepted"
        return result
    result.steps = params.end_time / definition.step
    result.segment_energy = [for segment := system.segments[] then 0.0]
    field := [for p := (0:<int(system.plate.count))[] then params.initial]
    observe(&result, system, params, 0, field)
    for: step < result.steps
        sources := source_terms(system.sources, system.plate.count, step * definition.step)
        next := transient.advance(definition.method, system.plate.width, system.plate.height, system.plate.neighbors, system.g, system.theta, system.boundary, system.capacity, field, sources.field, definition.dt)
        for: i < int(#system.segments)
            result.segment_energy[i] += step_energy(system, system.segments[i], definition, field, next[0], next[1])
        result.generated += definition.dt * sources.power
        field = next[0]
        observe(&result, system, params, (step + 1) * definition.step, field)
    result.final = field
    result.stored = stored_heat(system, field, params.initial, [for p := (0:<int(system.plate.count))[] then p])
    result.boundary = transient.sum(result.segment_energy)
    result.balanced = absolute(result.stored - result.boundary - result.generated) <= 0.000001 * (absolute(result.stored) + absolute(result.boundary) + absolute(result.generated))
    return result

class Iterative(steady.Iteration iteration, real64 rate, string[] milestones, real64 max_error, real64 residual)
class SteadyResult(real64[] rhs, real64[] solution, real64[] base, real64[][] responses, Iterative[] iterations, real64 rho, real64 omega_opt)

SteadyResult solve_steady(System system, Params params)
    rhs := system.beta + system.source_all
    vectors := [rhs, system.beta]
    for source := system.sources[]
        real64[] vector := [for p := (0:<int(system.plate.count))[] then 0.0]
        for p := source.cells[]
            vector[p] = 1.0 / real64(#source.cells)
        vectors = vectors.append(vector)
    fields := steady.band_solve(system.plate.width, system.plate.neighbors, system.g, system.diagonal, vectors)
    solution := fields[0]
    base := fields[1]
    responses := fields[2:<int(#fields)]
    jacobi := steady.iterate(system.plate.neighbors, system.g, system.theta, system.boundary, system.diagonal, system.source_all, params.initial, params.tolerance, params.max_iterations, "jacobi", 1.0)
    count := int(#jacobi.changes)
    rho := math.sqrt(jacobi.changes[count - 1] / jacobi.changes[count - 3])
    real64 omega_opt := 2.0 / (1.0 + math.sqrt(1.0 - rho * rho))
    iterations := [jacobi]
    for method := ["gauss_seidel", "sor", "sor_estimated"][]
        iterations = iterations.append(steady.iterate(system.plate.neighbors, system.g, system.theta, system.boundary, system.diagonal, system.source_all, params.initial, params.tolerance, params.max_iterations, method, (if method == "sor_estimated" then omega_opt else params.omega)))
    Iterative[] results := []
    for iteration := iterations[]
        k := int(#iteration.changes)
        rate := math.sqrt(iteration.changes[k - 1] / iteration.changes[k - 3])
        string[] milestones := []
        for factor := [1000, 100, 10, 1][]
            milestone := "never"
            for: i < k
                if iteration.changes[i] < params.tolerance * real64(factor)
                    milestone = string(i + 1)
                    break
            milestones = milestones.append(milestone)
        real64 difference := 0.0
        for: p < system.plate.count
            difference = maximum(difference, absolute(iteration.field[p] - solution[p]))
        residual := steady.residual(system.plate.neighbors, system.g, system.diagonal, iteration.field, rhs)
        results = results.append(Iterative(iteration, rate, milestones, difference, residual))
    return SteadyResult(rhs, solution, base, responses, results, rho, omega_opt)

real64[] selected(real64[] field, int[] cells)
    return [for p := cells[] then field[p]]

real64[] extrema(real64[] values)
    low := values[0]
    high := values[0]
    for value := values[]
        low = minimum(low, value)
        high = maximum(high, value)
    return [low, high]

string[] steady_lines(System system, Params params, SteadyResult result)
    solution := result.solution
    count := system.plate.count
    string[] lines := [summary("steady", system, solution)].concat(report.temperatures(system.plate.width, system.plate.height, solution))
    for: i < int(#system.material_list)
        material := system.material_list[i]
        values := selected(solution, system.material_cells[i])
        ends := extrema(values)
        lines = lines.append("material {material.code} {material.name} cells {#values} min " + report.real_text(ends[0], 2) + " max " + report.real_text(ends[1], 2) + " mean " + report.real_text(transient.sum(values) / real64(#values), 2))
    real64[] duties := []
    for source := system.sources[]
        duty := source.duty(params.end_time)
        duties = duties.append(duty)
        values := selected(solution, source.cells)
        ends := extrema(values)
        lines = lines.append("source {source.name} power " + report.real_text(source.power, 4) + " duty " + report.real_text(duty, 4) + " mean " + report.real_text(transient.sum(values) / real64(#values), 2) + " max " + report.real_text(ends[1], 2))
    for source := system.sources[]
        for: i < int(#system.sources)
            coefficient := transient.sum(selected(result.responses[i], source.cells)) / real64(#source.cells)
            lines = lines.append("influence {source.name} {system.sources[i].name} " + report.real_text(coefficient, 4))
    real64 maximum_error := 0.0
    real64[] duty_field := []
    for: p < count
        value := result.base[p]
        average := value
        for: i < int(#system.sources)
            value += system.sources[i].power * result.responses[i][p]
            average += (duties[i] * system.sources[i].power) * result.responses[i][p]
        maximum_error = maximum(maximum_error, absolute(value - solution[p]))
        duty_field = duty_field.append(average)
    lines = lines.append("superposition " + verdict(maximum_error <= 0.000001))
    for: i < int(#system.sources)
        for segment := system.segments[]
            real64[] terms := []
            if segment.kind != "insulated"
                for face := segment.faces[]
                    terms = terms.append(system.g[face[0]][face[1]] * result.responses[i][face[0]])
            lines = lines.append("path {system.sources[i].name} {segment.name} " + report.real_text(transient.sum(terms), 4))
    lines = lines.append(summary("duty_steady", system, duty_field))
    for: i < int(#system.sources)
        source := system.sources[i]
        real64 limiting := 0.0
        selected_cell := 0
        for: p < count
            power := (params.limit - (solution[p] - source.power * result.responses[i][p])) / result.responses[i][p]
            if p == 0 or power < limiting
                limiting = power
                selected_cell = p
        lines = lines.append("headroom {source.name} max_power " + report.real_text(limiting, 4) + " at " + cell_text(system.plate.width, selected_cell))
    material_count := int(#system.material_list)
    faces_count := [for i := (0:<int(material_count))[] then [for j := (0:<int(material_count))[] then 0]]
    real64[][] forward := [for i := (0:<int(material_count))[] then [for j := (0:<int(material_count))[] then 0.0]]
    backward := forward
    real64 gradient := -1.0
    first_point := 0
    second_point := 0
    for: p < count
        for direction := [1, 3][]
            q := system.plate.neighbors[p][direction]
            if q >= 0
                current_gradient := absolute(solution[p] - solution[q]) / system.plate.dx
                if current_gradient > gradient
                    gradient = current_gradient
                    first_point = p
                    second_point = q
                a := system.cell_material[p]
                b := system.cell_material[q]
                if a != b
                    flow := system.g[p][direction] * (solution[p] - solution[q])
                    if a > b
                        temporary := a
                        a = b
                        b = temporary
                        flow = -flow
                    faces_count[a][b] += 1
                    if flow > 0.0
                        forward[a][b] += flow
                    elif flow < 0.0
                        backward[a][b] += absolute(flow)
    for: a < material_count
        for: a + 1 <= b < material_count
            if faces_count[a][b] > 0
                lines = lines.append("interface {system.material_list[a].code} {system.material_list[b].code} faces {faces_count[a][b]} forward " + report.real_text(forward[a][b], 4) + " backward " + report.real_text(backward[a][b], 4))
    real64[] flows := []
    real64[] absolute_flows := []
    for segment := system.segments[]
        flow := segment_flow(system, segment, solution)
        flows = flows.append(flow)
        absolute_flows = absolute_flows.append(absolute(flow))
        lines = lines.append("segment {segment.name} {segment.edge} {segment.kind} flow " + report.real_text(flow, 4))
    balanced := absolute(transient.sum(flows) + system.total_power) <= 0.000001 * (transient.sum(absolute_flows) + system.total_power)
    lines = lines.concat(["sources " + report.real_text(system.total_power, 4), "balance " + verdict(balanced), "max_gradient " + report.real_text(gradient, 2) + " between " + cell_text(system.plate.width, first_point) + " and " + cell_text(system.plate.width, second_point)])
    for iteration := result.iterations[]
        solver := iteration.iteration
        prefix := "solver {solver.method}"
        if solver.method == "sor" or solver.method == "sor_estimated"
            prefix += " omega " + report.real_text(solver.omega, 4)
        lines = lines.append(prefix + " iterations {#solver.changes} converged " + yes(solver.converged) + " rate " + report.real_text(iteration.rate, 6) + " milestones " + iteration.milestones.join(" "))
    return lines

string rejected(RunResult result, bool with_maximum, real64 dt_max)
    definition := result.definition
    line := "run {definition.name} {definition.method} dt " + report.time_text(definition.step) + " rejected {result.state}"
    if with_maximum and result.state == "unstable"
        line += " max_dt " + report.real_text(dt_max, 4)
    return line

string[] snapshot_lines(System system, Params params, RunResult[] results)
    string[] lines := []
    for result := results[]
        if result.state != "accepted"
            lines = lines.append(rejected(result, true, system.dt_max))
        else
            definition := result.definition
            for snapshot := result.snapshots[]
                prefix := "run {definition.name} {definition.method} dt " + report.time_text(definition.step) + " time " + report.time_text(snapshot.recorded_at)
                lines = lines.append(summary(prefix, system, snapshot.field))
                lines = lines.concat(report.temperatures(system.plate.width, system.plate.height, snapshot.field))
    return lines

string[] probe_lines(Params params, RunResult[] results)
    lines := ["run,time,probe,temperature"]
    for result := results[]
        if result.state == "accepted"
            for sample := result.samples[]
                for: i < int(#params.probes)
                    lines = lines.append(result.definition.name + "," + report.time_text(sample.recorded_at) + "," + params.probes[i].name + "," + report.real_text(sample.values[i], 3))
    return lines

string[] comparison_lines(System system, Params params, RunResult[] results, int reference, SteadyResult solved)
    lines := ["ftcs_max_dt " + report.real_text(system.dt_max, 4)]
    for: index < int(#results)
        result := results[index]
        definition := result.definition
        if result.state != "accepted"
            lines = lines.append(rejected(result, false, system.dt_max))
        else
            alarm := if result.alarm_time < 0 then "never" else report.time_text(result.alarm_time) + " at " + cell_text(system.plate.width, result.alarm_cell)
            lines = lines.append("run {definition.name} {definition.method} dt " + report.time_text(definition.step) + " steps {result.steps} peak " + report.real_text(result.peak_temperature, 2) + " time " + report.time_text(result.peak_time) + " at " + cell_text(system.plate.width, result.peak_cell) + " alarm {alarm} above " + report.time_text(result.above))
            lines = lines.append("energy {definition.name} stored " + report.real_text(result.stored, 2) + " boundary " + report.real_text(result.boundary, 2) + " source " + report.real_text(result.generated, 2) + " balance " + verdict(result.balanced))
            for snapshot := result.snapshots[]
                lines = lines.append("energy_at {definition.name} time " + report.time_text(snapshot.recorded_at) + " stored " + report.real_text(snapshot.stored, 2) + " boundary " + report.real_text(snapshot.boundary, 2) + " source " + report.real_text(snapshot.generated, 2))
            for: i < int(#system.material_list)
                value := stored_heat(system, result.final, params.initial, system.material_cells[i])
                lines = lines.append("energy_material {definition.name} {system.material_list[i].code} " + report.real_text(value, 2))
            for: i < int(#system.segments)
                lines = lines.append("energy_segment {definition.name} {system.segments[i].name} " + report.real_text(result.segment_energy[i], 2))
            for: i < int(#params.probes)
                low := result.samples[0].values[i]
                high := low
                low_time := result.samples[0].recorded_at
                high_time := low_time
                for: 1 <= j < int(#result.samples)
                    sample := result.samples[j]
                    if sample.values[i] > high
                        high = sample.values[i]
                        high_time = sample.recorded_at
                    if sample.values[i] < low
                        low = sample.values[i]
                        low_time = sample.recorded_at
                lines = lines.append("probe_summary {definition.name} {params.probes[i].name} max " + report.real_text(high, 3) + " time " + report.time_text(high_time) + " min " + report.real_text(low, 3) + " time " + report.time_text(low_time))
            if index != reference
                for: i < int(#result.snapshots)
                    field := result.snapshots[i].field
                    reference_field := results[reference].snapshots[i].field
                    real64[] squares := []
                    real64 maximum_error := 0.0
                    for: p < system.plate.count
                        difference := absolute(field[p] - reference_field[p])
                        squares = squares.append(difference * difference)
                        maximum_error = maximum(maximum_error, difference)
                    rms := math.sqrt(transient.sum(squares) / real64(system.plate.count))
                    lines = lines.append("compare {definition.name} {params.reference} time " + report.time_text(result.snapshots[i].recorded_at) + " max_diff " + report.real_text(maximum_error, 6) + " rms_diff " + report.real_text(rms, 6))
            real64 difference := 0.0
            for: p < system.plate.count
                difference = maximum(difference, absolute(result.final[p] - solved.solution[p]))
            lines = lines.append("final {definition.name} steady_max_diff " + report.real_text(difference, 6))
    residual := steady.residual(system.plate.neighbors, system.g, system.diagonal, solved.solution, solved.rhs)
    lines = lines.append("steady direct max_residual " + report.real_text(residual, 6))
    for iteration := solved.iterations[]
        lines = lines.append("steady {iteration.iteration.method} iterations {#iteration.iteration.changes} max_diff " + report.real_text(iteration.max_error, 6) + " max_residual " + report.real_text(iteration.residual, 6))
    return lines.concat(["jacobi_spectral_radius " + report.real_text(solved.rho, 6) + " squared " + report.real_text(solved.rho * solved.rho, 6), "omega_estimated " + report.real_text(solved.omega_opt, 4)])

string[] isotherm_lines(System system, Params params, SteadyResult solved, RunResult reference)
    map_result := report.isotherms(system.plate.width, system.plate.height, solved.solution, params.bands)
    string[] lines := ["isotherms steady counts " + [for count := map_result.counts[] then string(count)].join(" ")].concat(map_result.rows)
    for snapshot := reference.snapshots[]
        map_result = report.isotherms(system.plate.width, system.plate.height, snapshot.field, params.bands)
        lines = lines.append("isotherms {params.reference} time " + report.time_text(snapshot.recorded_at) + " counts " + [for count := map_result.counts[] then string(count)].join(" "))
        lines = lines.concat(map_result.rows)
    return lines

void run()
    plate := mesh.read_plate()
    materials.Material[] material_list := materials.read_materials()
    data := read_boundary(plate)
    params := read_parameters(plate.width)
    system := build_system(plate, material_list, data)
    solved := solve_steady(system, params)
    RunResult[] results := []
    reference := -1
    for: i < int(#params.runs)
        results = results.append(simulate(params.runs[i], system, params))
        if params.runs[i].name == params.reference
            reference = i
    report.write("snapshots.txt", snapshot_lines(system, params, results))
    report.write("probes.csv", probe_lines(params, results))
    report.write("steady_state.txt", steady_lines(system, params, solved))
    report.write("solver_comparison.txt", comparison_lines(system, params, results, reference, solved))
    report.write("isotherms.txt", isotherm_lines(system, params, solved, results[reference]))

run()

class Mesh(int width, int height, real64 dx, real64 thickness, string[] codes)

    for: row < height
        for: column < width
            local p := row * width + column
            neighbors = neighbors.append([(if column > 0 then p - 1 else -1), (if column + 1 < width then p + 1 else -1), (if row > 0 then p - width else -1), (if row + 1 < height then p + width else -1)])

int[][] segment_faces(int width, int height, string edge, int first, int last)
    int[][] result := []
    for: first <= coordinate <= last
        if edge == "top"
            result = result.append([cell(width, 0, coordinate), 2])
        elif edge == "bottom"
            result = result.append([cell(width, height - 1, coordinate), 3])
        elif edge == "left"
            result = result.append([cell(width, coordinate, 0), 0])
        else
            result = result.append([cell(width, coordinate, width - 1), 1])
    return result

    int[] result := []
    for: first_row <= row <= last_row

            result = result.append(cell(width, row, column))
    return result

import math

string padded(int value, int width)
    text := string(value)
    return "0" * nat(width - int(#text)) + text

string real_text(real64 value, int places)
    factor := 10 ^ places
    magnitude := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    rounded := math.floor(magnitude * real64(factor) + 0.5)
    sign := if value < 0.0 and rounded != 0 then "-" else ""
    return sign + string(rounded / factor) + "." + padded(rounded % factor, places)

string time_text(int milliseconds)
    return string(milliseconds / 1000) + "." + padded(milliseconds % 1000, 3)

string[] temperatures(int width, int height, real64[] field)
    string[] result := []
    for: row < height
        result = result.append([for column := (0:<int(width))[] then real_text(field[row * width + column], 2)].join(" "))
    return result

class Map(int[] counts, string[] rows)

Map isotherms(int width, int height, real64[] field, real64[] bands)
    hottest := 0
    for: p < int(#field)
        if field[p] > field[hottest]
            hottest = p
    counts := [for i := (0:<(int(#bands) + 1))[] then 0]
    string[] characters := []
    for: p < int(#field)
        digit := 0
        for band := bands[]
            if field[p] >= band
                digit += 1
        counts[digit] += 1
        characters = characters.append(if p == hottest then "*" else string(digit))
    rows := [for row := (0:<int(height))[] then characters[row * width:<(row + 1) * width].join("")]
    return Map(counts, rows)

import transient = "./transient.qui"

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

real64 g_value(int[][] neighbors, real64[][] conductance, real64[][] theta, bool[][] boundary, real64[] source_all, real64[] field, int point)
    real64[] terms := []
    for: direction < 4
        neighbor := neighbors[point][direction]
        if neighbor >= 0
            terms = terms.append(conductance[point][direction] * field[neighbor])
        elif boundary[point][direction]
            terms = terms.append(conductance[point][direction] * theta[point][direction])
    return transient.sum(terms) + source_all[point]

class Iteration(string method, real64[] field, real64[] changes, bool converged, real64 omega)

Iteration iterate(int[][] neighbors, real64[][] conductance, real64[][] theta, bool[][] boundary, real64[] diagonal, real64[] source_all, real64 initial, real64 tolerance, int maximum, string method, real64 omega)
    count := int(#diagonal)
    field := [for p := (0:<int(count))[] then initial]
    real64[] changes := []
    for: iteration < maximum
        previous := field
        real64[] updated := [for p := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]
        for: p < count
            target := g_value(neighbors, conductance, theta, boundary, source_all, (if method == "jacobi" then previous else field), p) / diagonal[p]
            if method == "jacobi"
                updated[p] = target
            elif method == "gauss_seidel"
                field[p] = target
            else
                field[p] += omega * (target - field[p])
        if method == "jacobi"
            field = updated
        real64 change := 0.0
        for: p < count
            difference := absolute(field[p] - previous[p])
            if difference > change
                change = difference
        changes = changes.append(change)
        if change < tolerance
            break
    return Iteration(method, field, changes, changes[-1] < tolerance, omega)

real64[][] band_solve(int width, int[][] neighbors, real64[][] conductance, real64[] diagonal, real64[][] right_hand_sides)
    count := int(#diagonal)
    real64[][] matrix := [for p := (0:<int(count))[] then [for offset := (0:<(int(2 * width) + 1))[] then 0.0]]
    for: p < count
        matrix[p][width] = diagonal[p]
        for: direction < 4
            neighbor := neighbors[p][direction]
            if neighbor >= 0
                matrix[p][neighbor - p + width] = -conductance[p][direction]
    vectors := right_hand_sides
    for: column < count
        stop := if column + width < count then column + width else count - 1
        for: column + 1 <= row <= stop
            factor := matrix[row][column - row + width] / matrix[column][width]
            matrix[row][column - row + width] = 0.0
            for: column + 1 <= following <= stop
                matrix[row][following - row + width] -= factor * matrix[column][following - column + width]
            for: i < int(#vectors)
                vectors[i][row] -= factor * vectors[i][column]
    real64[][] solutions := []
    for values := vectors[]
        real64[] field := [for p := (0:<int(count))[] then 0.0]
        row := count - 1
        while row >= 0
            value := values[row]
            stop := if row + width < count then row + width else count - 1
            for: row + 1 <= column <= stop
                value -= matrix[row][column - row + width] * field[column]
            field[row] = value / matrix[row][width]
            row -= 1
        solutions = solutions.append(field)
    return solutions

real64 residual(int[][] neighbors, real64[][] conductance, real64[] diagonal, real64[] field, real64[] rhs)
    real64 maximum := 0.0
    for: p < int(#field)
        value := rhs[p]
        for: direction < 4
            neighbor := neighbors[p][direction]
            if neighbor >= 0
                value += conductance[p][direction] * field[neighbor]
        value -= diagonal[p] * field[p]
        magnitude := absolute(value)
        if magnitude > maximum
            maximum = magnitude
    return maximum

real64 sum(real64[] values)
    if #values == 0
        return 0.0
    result := values[0]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#values)
        result += values[i]
    return result

real64 flow(int[][] neighbors, real64[][] conductance, real64[][] theta, bool[][] boundary, real64[] field, int point, int first, int last)
    real64[] terms := []
    for: first <= direction <= last
        neighbor := neighbors[point][direction]
        g := conductance[point][direction]
        if neighbor >= 0
            terms = terms.append(g * (field[neighbor] - field[point]))
        elif boundary[point][direction]
            terms = terms.append(g * (theta[point][direction] - field[point]))
    return sum(terms)

real64[] thomas(real64[] lower, real64[] diagonal, real64[] upper, real64[] rhs)
    length := int(#diagonal)
    up := [upper[0] / diagonal[0]]
    rp := [rhs[0] / diagonal[0]]
    for: 1 <= i < length
        pivot := diagonal[i] - lower[i] * up[i - 1]
        up = up.append(upper[i] / pivot)
        rp = rp.append((rhs[i] - lower[i] * rp[i - 1]) / pivot)
    real64[] result := [for i := (0:<int(length))[] then 0.0]
    result[length - 1] = rp[length - 1]
    i := length - 2
    while i >= 0
        result[i] = rp[i] - up[i] * result[i + 1]
        i -= 1
    return result

real64[] sweep(int width, int height, int[][] neighbors, real64[][] conductance, real64[][] theta, bool[][] boundary, real64[] capacity, real64 tau, real64[] rhs, bool horizontal)
    line_count := if horizontal then height else width
    length := if horizontal then width else height
    first := if horizontal then 0 else 2
    second := first + 1
    real64[] field := [for i := (0:<int(width * height))[] then 0.0]
    for: line < line_count
        cells := [for i := (0:<int(length))[] then (if horizontal then line * width + i else i * width + line)]
        real64[] lower := []
        real64[] diagonal := []
        real64[] upper := []
        real64[] values := []
        for point := cells[]
            a := conductance[point][first]
            b := conductance[point][second]
            lower = lower.append(if neighbors[point][first] >= 0 then -a else 0.0)
            diagonal = diagonal.append(capacity[point] / tau + a + b)
            upper = upper.append(if neighbors[point][second] >= 0 then -b else 0.0)
            value := rhs[point]
            if boundary[point][first]
                value += a * theta[point][first]
            if boundary[point][second]
                value += b * theta[point][second]
            values = values.append(value)
        solved := thomas(lower, diagonal, upper, values)
        for: i < length
            field[cells[i]] = solved[i]
    return field

real64[][] advance(string method, int width, int height, int[][] neighbors, real64[][] conductance, real64[][] theta, bool[][] boundary, real64[] capacity, real64[] field, real64[] source, real64 dt)
    count := width * height
    real64[] rhs := []
    if method == "ftcs"
        for: p < count
            rhs = rhs.append(field[p] + dt * (flow(neighbors, conductance, theta, boundary, field, p, 0, 3) + source[p]) / capacity[p])
        return [rhs, []]
    tau := if method == "crank_nicolson" then dt / 2.0 else dt
    real64[] vertical := []
    for: p < count
        value := flow(neighbors, conductance, theta, boundary, field, p, 2, 3)
        vertical = vertical.append(value)
        rhs = rhs.append(capacity[p] / tau * field[p] + value + source[p])
    intermediate := sweep(width, height, neighbors, conductance, theta, boundary, capacity, tau, rhs, true)
    for: p < count
        if method == "backward_euler"
            rhs[p] = capacity[p] / dt * intermediate[p] - vertical[p]
        else
            rhs[p] = capacity[p] / tau * intermediate[p] + flow(neighbors, conductance, theta, boundary, intermediate, p, 0, 1) + source[p]
    return [sweep(width, height, neighbors, conductance, theta, boundary, capacity, tau, rhs, false), intermediate]
